body.name: Coded-law identified set
body.construction: For the fixed measurable code \(\kappa\), \(\Theta(p)=\{Q(M):M\in M_G,\ p_M=p\}\), with endpoints \(q^-(p)=\inf\Theta(p)\) and \(q^+(p)=\sup\Theta(p)\). This set conditions only on the coded law and is not the identified set induced by the unbinned continuous observational law.
